title: ScheduleImpactAssessment
description: Stage D output. Critical path and float analysis for inserting the emergent activity into the current outage schedule. Answers the question an outage manager actually manages: how much float does this consume, is it on the critical path, and what does it displace? Built by connecting the EmergentWorkWorkflow to the existing CriticalPathRiskAnalyzer and ScheduleGraph.

schedule_version_id.description: Identifier of the schedule version against which impact was computed. Must match OutageDataset.schedule_versions.

schedule_loader_unavailable.description: True in the degraded-mode stub produced when the schedule could not be loaded; downstream stages run without CP metrics.

crew_continuity.description: Crew-continuity assessment at the insertion point.

permit_lead_time.description: Permit / clearance lead-time assessment for the insertion.

insertion_point.description: Where in the schedule network the emergent activity would be inserted for this assessment.

emergent_task_id.description: Synthetic id assigned to the emergent task in the modified network (e.g. EA::<activity_id>).

after_task_id.description: Task after which the emergent activity would start.

before_task_id.description: Task that would be delayed by this insertion.

duration_estimate.description: Probabilistic duration estimate derived from historical analogs (Stage E feeds back to refine this) or the fallback population.

confidence_tier.description: data_supported: based on ≥5 historical analogs with good similarity. sme_informed: based on fewer analogs or SME-adjusted estimate. low_confidence: fallback population or no analog data available.

sample_size.description: Number of historical analogs used to fit the distribution.

float_consumed_hours.description: Total float consumed by inserting this activity at the assessed insertion point using the p50 duration estimate.

available_float_before.description: Total float available on the affected path before insertion (real-stage spelling).

available_float_before_hours.description: Total float available on the affected path before insertion (degraded-stub spelling).

remaining_float_after.description: Remaining float after insertion (real-stage spelling). Negative values indicate a new critical path.

is_critical_path_impact.description: True if inserting this activity at p50 duration would consume all available float and extend the critical path.

criticality_label.description: critical: activity is on or will force the critical path. near_critical: less than 8 hours of float remaining after insertion. non_critical: sufficient float available. unknown: schedule unavailable (degraded stub).

cp_impact.description: Critical path impact metrics. Produced by CriticalPathRiskAnalyzer. estimated_new_cp_hours / cp_drag_hours are null when CP impact could not be computed (cp_impact_unavailable).

baseline_cp_hours.description: Baseline critical path duration for this schedule version.

estimated_new_cp_hours.description: Estimated new critical path duration after inserting the emergent activity at p50 duration. Null when cp_impact_unavailable.

cp_drag_hours.description: Expected increase in project duration attributable to this insertion. 0 if non-critical, null when cp_impact_unavailable.

cp_impact_unavailable.description: True when CP impact could not be computed (e.g. the duration distribution was unknown, so the Monte Carlo was skipped).

cp_impact_unavailable_reason.description: Why CP impact is unavailable, e.g. 'duration_distribution_unknown'.

cp_sensitivity_score.description: Point-biserial correlation between this activity's criticality status and project finish time, from Monte Carlo simulation. Values near 1.0 indicate this activity most reliably predicts delays when critical.

p80_cp_hours.description: P80 critical path duration from Monte Carlo simulation using the duration distribution.

p90_cp_hours.description: P90 critical path duration from Monte Carlo simulation.

locked_baseline_cp_hours.description: Locked baseline critical-path duration, when a baseline schedule version is loaded.

schedule_variance_hours.description: Variance of the current schedule against the locked baseline.

total_overrun_hours.description: Total overrun against the locked baseline.

projected_finish_after_insertion.description: Projected finish timestamp after inserting the emergent activity.

displaced_tasks.description: Tasks that would be delayed as a result of inserting this emergent activity.

es_shift_hours.description: Early-start shift (hours) applied to this task by the insertion.

new_float_hours.description: Task total float after the insertion.

has_regulatory_constraint.description: True if the displaced task has a TS, NRC, or CAP constraint that limits how long it can be deferred.

resource_conflicts.description: Resource conflicts identified at the proposed insertion point.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in this schedule impact assessment, accounting for duration estimate uncertainty and schedule data completeness.

notes.description: Analyst-visible notes about assumptions, limitations, or caveats for this assessment.
